addons.name: Half Day Guide Trip: Lake of the Ozarks

blurb: Expert Angling Guide Service offers guided fishing trips of 4, 6, and 8 hours targeting bass, crappie, catfish, hybrid stripers, and other seasonal species on Lake of the Ozarks. They also provide 2-hour hands-on fishing electronics training to help anglers optimize their fish finders and sonar systems. Trips include all gear, bait, and fish cleaning services, tailored to all skill levels.
extraNote: No deposit required; payment at end of trip by cash or Venmo · Catch and release for bass; fish cleaning included for catfish, crappie, white bass · Trips adapt to weather, seasonal patterns, and fish activity · Typically launch from Public Beach 2 or other public ramps; private dock pickups available on request.
